result.stdout:
usage: daventry <game-folder> [options]
  --scale N          initial window or screenshot scale factor (default 3); the window can be resized
  --fullscreen       start in full screen (Alt+Enter or F11 toggles it while playing)
  --aspect           show the picture at 4:3 as a CRT did (Ctrl+Alt+A toggles it while playing)
  --frames N         exit after N ticks (for smoke tests)
  --list             detect and print games, do not run
  --info             load every resource and print statistics, do not run
  --picture N        start in the picture viewer at picture N (AGI and SCI)
  --view N           place view N on the picture as ego (AGI cycles its cels; SCI: L and C step loops and cels)
  --screenshot FILE  render headless and write the frame as PNG, do not open a window
  --wav FILE         headless: also write the audio the engine played as a WAV
  --enter-every N    headless: press Enter every N ticks
  --type T:text,...  headless: type text and Enter at tick T
  --key T:name,...   headless: press a key (escape, return, up, f1, ...) at tick T
  --click T:x,y;...  headless: click the left mouse button at (x, y) at tick T
  --save T:N,...     headless: save the game to slot N at tick T
  --restore T:N,...  headless: restore slot N at tick T (SCI)
  --saves DIR        headless: folder for saved games (default: in memory)
  --seed N           headless: seed for the games' random numbers (default 1; a headless run repeats exactly)
  --sound NAME       sound hardware: AGI pcjr (default), pc, ramp, amiga or mac; SCI adlib (default), pcjr or pc
  --no-digital-sfx   SCI: play the AdLib version of sound effects that also have a digital sample
  --volume N         master volume in percent (default 75, ScummVM's level); Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down and Ctrl+Alt+M while playing
  --verbose          debug logging
